buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE 50% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up to 50 percent at the time of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 50 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 50 percent with the consent of the service provider 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses ANNEXURE–1A STANDARD ADDITIONAL TERMS & CONDITIONS ( ATCs) FOR MONTHLY LIGHT MOTOR VEHICLE (LMV) HIRING SERVICES 1. SCOPE OF WORK 1.1 Hiring Details Hiring of One No. of Vehicles (SUV, type Mahindra Bolero or equivalent vehicle) commercial category vehicles, on a monthly basis for a period of 24 months, with a provision of one driver per vehicle on 12 hours (staggered with intermittent rest) extendabl e by up to 12 months, if required, at CMPDI, RI-VII, Bhubaneswar. 1.2 Vehicle specifications & acceptance criteria a. Age of Vehicle Maximum age of vehicle shall be (02) years, counted from the date of first regist ration, as on the date of deployment.

b. Mandatory Features All vehicles must: Be BS-VI compliant or of the latest technology Be commercially registered Be air-conditioned Have GPS, SOS, and Dashcam installed Have Fastag with sufficient balance Be equipped with First Aid Kit c. SUV should have the enough space to accommodate 02 (Two) number of Standard PM 10 Sampler (For machine specification please visit : https://www.envirotechinstruments.i n/ambient-air-pm10-samplers.html) and 02 (Two) nos. of Standard PM2.5 (For machine s pecification please visit:https://www.envirotechinstruments.in/ambient-air-pm2-5-samp lers.html) https://www.envirotechinstruments.in/ambient-air-pm10-samplers.html samp ler along with gaseous sampling attachment. d. Interior & Cleanliness Vehicles shall be: Clean, sanitized, and odour-free Provided with clean seat covers and towels Maintained in sound running condition at all times e. Documentation Each vehicle shall possess valid: Registration Certificate Insurance Permit (National permit also shall be obtained as and when required on imm ediate basis) Fitness Certificate Road Tax & statutory clearances f. Only commercially registered vehicles with valid taxi permits shall be deployed. g. The owner/agency/entity shall possess valid GST registration (where applicable) and Permanent Account Number (PAN). 1.3 Hiring Rates & Inclusions a. The quoted Basic Hiring Rate shall be inclusive of all Central/State statutory t axes and applicable GST excluding Fuel Charges (Diesel/Petrol & AdBlue (D iesel Exhaust Fluid-DEF), if applicable). b. The hiring rate shall be inclusive of: • Vehicle repairs and maintenance • Lubricants, engine oil, and consumables • Driver’s salary and all allowances, excluding night halt allowance • All direct and indirect expenses. The following shall be reimbursed separately by CMPDI on actuals: • Toll tax • Parking charges • Entry tax / State border tax (if applicable)

c. No escalation/change in rates shall be allowed during the entire contract period on any account including increase in fuel price, vehicle cost, POL, maintenance or spare parts. 1.4 Monthly Running Each vehicle shall run approximately 4000 km per month, which may vary de pending on requirements. Extra running beyond 4000 km shall be reimbursed as per Clause 2.2 Fuel shall be initially arranged by the Contractor and reimbursed by CMPDI o n actuals, subject to prescribed mileage norms and verification through Log Books and fuel receipts. 1.5 Operational Area Vehicles shall normally operate within state of Odisha, mostly in mines of MCL situated in Talcher coalfiled sin Anugola district and IB Valley coalfields in Jharsug uda and Sundaragaada districts and surrounding areas, but may be required to o perate anywhere in India as per CMPDI requirement. For the same, the deployed vehicles shall possess National Permit. The base location will be CMPDI, RI-VII, Bh ubaneswar office. If and when required, the vehicle will be used in Sundays and holidays and have to be stationed at the office or premises or the place as directed by the controlling authority i .e. HOD (Environment) /OIC (REC Lab). 1.6 Contractor’s Local Office The contractor shall establish an office and deploy adequate staff at Bhubaneswa r to ensure smooth execution. 1.7 Vehicle Control & Deployment / providing of hired vehicle: a. Vehicles and drivers shall remain exclusively under the control of CMPDI o r its authorized representative and it shall not be moved elsewhere without permi ssion. b. Deployment / providing of hired vehicle: The successful bidder shall deploy vehicles as per the GeM contract. The Contract or shall submit self-attested copies of all relevant documents, including DTO/RTO registration papers, insurance certificates, and any other statutory documents of t he vehicles, to the Department. 2. FUEL, ADBLUE REIMBURSEMENT 2.1 Fuel Supply The contractor shall ensure that sufficient fuel is available in the vehicles at the ti me of reporting on duty. It is the responsibility of the contractor to maintain fuel i n the vehicle throughout the duty period. In case of non-availability/non-reporting of vehicle on duty due to any fault on the part of the contractor, CMPDI may take appropriate penal actions as deemed fit.

2.2 Fuel Reimbursement a. Fuel cost shall be reimbursed by CMPDI based on actual kilometers run and prescribed mileage norms given below: Vehicle Type Mileage (km/litre) SUV (Bolero/Scorpio/Ertiga or equivalent) 10 Sedan (Tigor/Dzire or equivalent) 12 MUV (Camper or equivalent) 10 Premium SUV (Innova Crysta or equivalent) 8 b. Fuel reimbursement shall be made at the prevailing market rate of diesel/p etrol (preferably of PSU Oil Companies) at the place of engagement. c. For the purpose of reimbursement, the fuel rate shall be taken on a lower bas is, i.e. the lowest of the following: i. the rate applicable on the date of deployment, or ii. the average fuel rate of the relevant month, as supported by original fuel cash memos/receipts issued by authorized fuel o utlets. d. The reimbursable quantity of fuel shall be calculated based on actual kilometr es run as per odometer readings, the odometer reading will start from the con tractor's parking area, and the closing reading will be taken up to the contractor's parking area. A distance of up to 10 km, each way, will be allowed between CMPD I RI-VII, Bhubaneswar Office and the contractor's parking. Subject to the prescribe d mileage norms for the respective make and model of vehicle. e. If the actual fuel consumption claimed by the contractor exceeds the admissi ble fuel quantity calculated as per the prescribed mileage norms, reimbursem ent shall be limited to the admissible quantity only, and no additional cla im shall be entertained under any circumstances. 2.3 AdBlue Reimbursement for Diesel Driven Vehicles (if Applicable) For BS-VI diesel LMVs: 1.2 litres per 1000 km, subject to Log Book verification. 3.TOLL, PARKING & OTHER REIMBURSEMENTS 3.1 Toll Tax, Border/Entry Tax, Temporary Permit fees and Parking Charges shall b e reimbursed on submission of original receipts/FasTag statements, duly cert ified by the Authorized User/controlling officer, along with bills. 3.2 FasTag with sufficient balance is mandatory. Penalty due to insufficient balanc e shall not be reimbursed. 3.3 The vehicle may have to go outside the State as per requirement and for this, if any additional permit is required, the contractor has to arrange this. However, a ny additional cost for obtaining such permits from transport authority shall be rei mbursed by the CMPDI after production of required documentary evidence.

4. DUTY HOURS & ALLOWANCES 4.1 Duty Hours a. Vehicles shall be used for official duty for 8/12 hours per day (stagger ed shift with intermittent rest). b. Vehicles may be deployed for local and outstation duties, including Sun days and holidays, without restriction on kilometers per day. 4.2 Night Allowance Outstation duty involving night halt: ₹500/- (Rupees Five Hundred only) per night per vehicle, duly certified by Authorized User/Officer In-charge. 5. PERSONNEL REQUIREMENTS & VEHICLE MANAGEMENT 5.1 Driver Requirements a. Drivers must possess valid driving license, be experienced, literate, courteous, of good character and not under the influence of alcohol or drugs. b. Drivers shall be well dressed and carry sufficient money for journey expenses. c. CMPDI reserves the right to demand replacement of any driver for unsatisfactor y conduct, immediately. d. Boarding, lodging, food, accommodation and social needs of drivers shall be bo rne by the contractor. e. The driver shall report to duty as per the requirements of the CMPDI. f. The driver of the vehicle will have to maintain phone connection for easy access . The driver shall keep the mobile phone in silent or vibration mode, while driving the vehicle. 5.2 Vehicle Condition & Stationing a. Vehicles shall be clean, sanitized, odour-free, and maintained in sound running condition. b. Seats shall have clean covers and towels. c. Air-conditioner must be functional at all times during duty. d. Music system of the vehicle should be in working condition. e. The vehicles have to be stationed at the office or premises or the place as direc ted by the controlling authority or his representative. 5.3 Maintenance a. All maintenance, servicing, repairs, and spares, overall cleanliness of the vehicl es shall be arranged by the contractor at own cost. b. During maintenance/repair period, no fuel/engine-oil shall be reimbursed in any case.

c. Routine Maintenance Off: One day per month may be allowed for routine servicing, subject to CMPDI convenience. 5.4 Breakdown & Replacement In case of breakdown, contractor shall provide an immediate replacement vehicle of equivalent capacity of same age or lower age in replacement of the breakdown vehicle, in good conditions along with requisite documents after receiving breakd own information at no extra cost. No hiring charges shall be payable for the perio d of non-availability. 5.5 Seizure If the vehicle is seized by the authority under law or for election duty, CMPDI will n ot be liable for the same & no payment of whatsoever nature will be demanded fo r such event. In such condition the contractor will provide alternate vehicle for CM PDI without delay. 5.6 Replacement of vehicle(s) The contractor may request in writing for change of vehicles to be deployed by him at any time at his option as follows: a. In case the contractor is a Travel Agency/JV firm/ Partnership firm / ve hicle hiring agreement: the contractor may deploy any other vehicle(s) o f same class owned by him subsequently or hired subsequently through a hiring agreement, of the same or lower age than the originally offered vehicle(s). b. In case the contractor is Owner of Vehicle: the contractor may deploy any other vehicle(s) of same class owned by him subsequently of the sa me or lower age than the originally offered vehicle(s). However, such requests as stated at (a) and (b) above, will be considered by the department on the merit of the individual case. In case, the request for change of vehicle(s) is (are) not accepted by the engineer In-charge/accepting authority, the n the bidder has to deploy the originally offered vehicle (s). 6. LOG BOOK MAINTENANCE 6.1 A proper Vehicle Log Book (as per Annexure-XIV) shall be maintained fo r each vehicle on a daily basis by the driver. The Log Book shall record odometer readings, time of departure and return, and details of all expenses incurred, inclu ding toll charges (supported by receipts/FasTag statements), parking charges, an d entry tax, if any. The Log Book shall be duly countersigned by the Controlli ng Authority/User of the vehicle. The driver shall produce the Vehicle Log Boo k to the user at the commencement and conclusion of each journey. 6.2 Each Log Book entry shall include the date, odometer readings (opening and closing), time in and time out, places visited, and details of toll char ges, parking fees, FasTag deductions, and entry tax, as applicable, and sha

ll be duly countersigned by the Controlling Authority/User. 6.3 The Log Book entries shall be filled in on the same day and shall be signed by both the concerned driver and the user at the time of release of the vehicle for that day. In case a vehicle is retained for more than one day, the abov e details shall be recorded separately for each day and signed by both the driv er and the user accordingly. 6.4 Any overwriting or correction in the Log Book shall be duly attested by the us er. 6.5 Bills not supported by Log Books shall not be processed for payment. 6.6 The Contractor shall get Log Books printed and approved by CMPDI before co mmencement. 7. PAYMENTS TERMS 7.1 Monthly bills shall be submitted within 15 days from the end of the respective billing month. 7.2 Payments for each month of hiring will be made to the Contractor on receipt of bills in duplicate from the Contractor, along with filled-in Log Book duly signed by the concerned driver and certified by Authorized User (s). 7.3 All bills should be addressed to General HoD (Environment), CMPDI, RI-VII, Bhubaneswar 7.4 Payments shall normally be made within 21 days of receipt of correct bills. 7.5 No interest shall be payable on delayed payments for reasons beyond CMPDI’ s control. 7.6 Except for the agreed rate of hiring, fuel reimbursement (Diesel or Petrol & A dBlue, if applicable), toll gate charge (if any), parking charges (if any) and entry t ax (if any), border tax/temporary permit, shall be reimbursed by the CMPDI, provi ded the Contractor submits documentary evidence of such payments, duly verifie d and signed by the controlling officer. No other charges whatsoever will be paid by CMPDI. 7.7 The CMPDI reserves the right to deduct / withhold any amount towards taxes, levies, etc. and to deal with such amount in terms of the provisions of the Statute or in terms of the direction of any statutory authority and the CMPDI shall only pro vide a certificate towards such deduction and shall not be responsible for any re ason whatsoever. 7.8 The CMPDI reserves the right to recover/enforce recovery of any overpayment s detected after the payment as a result of post payment audit or technical exami nation or by any other means, notwithstanding the fact that the amount of disput ed claims, if any, of the contractor exceeds the amount of such overpayment and irrespective of the facts whether such disputed claims of the contractor are the su

bject matter of dispute or not. 7.9 The amount of such overpayments shall be recovered from subsequent bills u nder the contract, failing that from contractor's claim under any other contract wi th the CMPDI or from the contractor's security deposit or the contractor shall pay t he amount of over payment on demand as applicable. In case of contractor's non- payment on such demand, the same should be realized from the contractor's due s, if any, with Coal India Limited or any of its subsidiaries. 7.10 Paying Authority: HOD(Finance), CMPDI, RI-VII, Bhubaneswar. 8. SCOPE & DURATION OF CONTRACT 8.1 Contract Period & Extension The contract shall be valid for two (02) years from the date of commencement a s specified in the GeM Contract and may be extended up to 12 months or till fin alization of a new contract, whichever is earlier, on the same rates and terms with mutual consent. 8.2 Requirement of additional vehicles The current requirement is based on the present work in hand. However, the num ber of vehicle(s) may be subsequently increased or reduced up to 10% (next rounded of f) of the ordered numbers of total vehicles, depending on the emergent need of th e CMPDI. Therefore, the CMPDI reserves the right for requisition of additional similar vehicle (s), as and when required, at the same rates and terms and conditions. All payme nt will be made on pro-rata basis of actual days of deployment of such additional v ehicle(s). 9. PENALTIES & LIQUIDATED DAMAGES 9.1 In cases where liquidated damages/penalties are not mentioned in the NIT, LD /Penalty shall be applicable as per the SLA of GeM provisions. 9.2 In case of a major accident/major breakdown, it shall be binding upon the cont ractor to provide substitute vehicle of equivalent capacity of same age or lower age in replacement of the breakdown of vehicle, in good conditions and with re quisite documents. 9.3 In the event that the contractor fails to provide a vehicle for any period, no hi ring charges shall be payable for that period. Additionally, an equivalent amo unt equal to the daily hiring charge shall be deducted from the contractor’s bill for the duration of the vehicle’s absence from duty. 10. STATUTORY COMPLIANCE & CLIP PORTAL 10.1 Labour & Statutory Laws Contractor shall comply with:

New Labour Codes Motor Vehicles Act Mines Act (where applicable) DTO/RTO rules All Central/State notifications 10.2 CLIP Registration a. Upon finalization of the contract, the Contractor shall register itself on the Cont ract Labour Information Portal (CLIP) of CIL (www.coalindia.in) within 30 days from the issuance of the Work Order/Contract. The Contractor shall enter and periodica lly update all information as required under the New Labour Codes. 10.3 Irrespective of running bills, the contractor shall submit all requisite docume nts to the concerned officials of the HR Department for issuance of the Labour Pay ment Certificate (LPC) for the respective month. The LPC shall be issued by the co ncerned officials of the HR Department of the respective RI/HQ of CMPDI. 10.4 All drivers engaged under the contract shall mandatorily mark biometric atte ndance at RI and HQ locations, and preferably at camps wherever such facility is available. 10.5 Indemnity Contractor shall indemnify CMPDI against all claims, penalties, litigations, and liab ilities arising out of non-compliance. 10.6 Compensation (In Case of Accident) CMPDI or the representative of CMPDI travelling in the vehicle shall not be responsible for payment of any cl aim or compensation of any kind to the contractor, its driver, or any third party arising out of: · Accident · Unlawful act of the driver · Mechanical failure or unfitness of the vehicle The contractor shall be exclusively responsible for payment of all such compensation, claims or liabilities. 11. LEGAL, LIABILITY & INDEMNITY 11.1 Contractor shall comply with all applicable Labour Laws, Motor Vehicles Act, Labour Codes, GST laws and statutory provisions applicable to the vehicles or the drivers employed for the above work. 11.2 CMPDI will not be liable for any act of the contractor which does not arise out of this contract. 11.3 CMPDI shall not be liable for accidents, injuries, death, compensation, theft o r loss related to contractor’s vehicles or staff. 11.4 Contractor shall fully indemnify CMPDI against all claims, losses, damages, p enalties or liabilities arising out of non-compliance or negligence. It is the sole res ponsibility of the bidder to keep their vehicles and accessories in safe custody; CM PDI shall not be responsible for theft of vehicles/parts/accessories while the vehicl es are on the duty of CMPDI. 11.5 If CMPDI suffers any loss on account of damage to its property, due to any fai

lure on the part of contractor or due to any act or omission or commission on the part of his representative/employees or from the vehicle of the contractor, the val ue of the same as assessed by the CMPDI, shall be recovered from the contractor’ s bill. The decision of the CMPDI in this regard shall be final and binding on the co ntractor. 11.6 The CMPDI shall have no responsibility regarding the appointment of staff/e mployees by the contractor for execution of the work and no obligations or liability will be borne by the CMPDI in case of death / permanent disability, etc/ dis putes between the contractor and his employed staff. 11.7 CMPDI, or the representative of CMPDI travelling in the vehicle, shall not be r esponsible in any way, for payment of any claim or compensation of any kind to th e Contractor, its driver or any other third person/party/agency against claim or co mpensation of any nature whatsoever, arising out of any accident or any other unl awful act of the driver and or due to unfitness of the vehicle(s). The Contractor sh all be exclusively responsible for such payments of compensation, if any. 12. INSTALLATION OF GPS, SOS & DASHCAM All vehicles operating under this contract must be equipped with GPS, SOS, and Dashcam systems. The contractor shall ensure proper maintenance and functioni ng of these devices at all times. The Dashcam system shall be capable of providin g video evidence in the event of any accident or incident. The respective Regi onal Institute (RI) or CMPDI Headquarters (HQ) shall be the custodian of al l Dashcam data, as applicable. 13. TERMINATION & MISCELLANEOUS 13.1 Safety Breach: Any compromise in passenger safety may lead to serious i mplications, eventually leading to termination. 13.2 Canvassing in any shape or form is strictly prohibited and shall lead to rejecti on of bid. 13.3 Contractor shall execute an Agreement on non-judicial stamp paper of ₹500/ - if the contract value exceeds ₹10,00,000/-, within one month from the com mencement of work.
